<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 18:24">Targ. Prov. XVIII, 24</cite> <cite ref="D00062"><he>דָּבֵיק</he></cite> ed. Lag.; a. e.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 111b:6">Keth. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>וכי אפשר לדְבוּקֵי</he>, v. <cite ref="D00072">preced.</cite> Nif.
<cite ref="Menachot 11a:16">Men. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>דַּבְּקֵיה לקומץ וכ׳</he> if he pasted the handfull of dough to the wall of the vessel.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ruth 1:14">Targ. Ruth I, 14</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Gittin 56b:18">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>מהו לאִידְּבוּקֵי בהו</he> how about joining their ranks?—
<cite ref="Pesachim 49a:15">Pes. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>לאִידְּבַק אנא בזרעיה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דאדבק בזרעיה</he>) that I should be connected with his descendants.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 14:3">Gen. R. s. 14</cite> <he>אית חספין מִתְדַּבְּקִין</he> can broken earthen vessels be joined together?

senses.gloss: to reach, overtake, attain to, obtain (corresp. to h. הִשִּׂיג).
units: Targ. O. Lev. XIV, 21 sq.; a. fr.—Part. pass. מַדְבַּק joined work.
